notes: ./register.ts hooks: session.start, command.run{command=skill-pick}, prompt.attachment{type=skill_listing}, prompt.submit, tool.call{tool=Skill}

./register.ts hooks on prompt.attachment do not run in a plugin a person installs where an organization manages Claude Code: there, these events pass over the plugins you install, and only a plugin the organization lists in managed settings runs them

./register.ts calls: $.clock.after, $.clock.now (via nowMs), $.clock.sleep (via enqueue, postJev, used), $.command.register, $.env.get (via jevKey, loadKey), $.http.fetch (via postJev), $.model.complete (via pick), $.session.cwd (via jevKey), $.store.get, $.store.set (via announceJev, clearLog, record), $.ui.toast (via announceJev)
